items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: So we went down and the next morning I’m staying at Mike Garson’s and the phone rings and Mike says, “Danny, it’s Horace Silver.”

ctx.x: Because they had a band meeting up there. He said, “he wants to use you but he can’t.” So we went down and the next morning I’m staying at Mike Garson’s and the phone rings and Mike says, “Danny, it’s Horace Silver.” And I said, “what?” I mean I must have got the gig, Horace Silver’s calling me. And you don’t forget it when you get a call from Horace Silver. He said, “Danny, it was obvious you were far superior to all those other drummers there. But there’s one other guy I want to hear in Philadelphia.” And that…
It’s ironic because they told Benny Goodman the same thing — you’re going to lose 40 percent of your work if you hire Lionel Hampton or whatever.
